mapper.select: SELECT id, 'HR_REQUEST_APPROVAL' AS source_type, request_type AS title, employee_id, status, NULL AS due_at, created_at FROM hr_request WHERE () AND ((status = 'PENDING_DEPT_APPROVAL' AND current_node = 'DEPT_APPROVAL') OR (status = 'PENDING_HR_APPROVAL' AND current_node = 'HR_APPROVAL')) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
